chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'From the mannerisms of the Prophets (may God's blessings be upon them) is love for women.'

key_terms.أخلاق الأنبياء: The mannerisms/character traits of the Prophets — a phrase indicating prophetically-endorsed behavior worthy of emulation
key_terms.حب النساء: Love for women — presented here as a positive prophetic trait, not merely permissible but characteristic of prophetic character

ai.seo_question: Is love for women a characteristic trait of the Prophets in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that love for women is a characteristic trait of the Prophets. This hadith comes at the opening of a chapter specifically devoted to marriage in Al-Kafi, establishing the prophetic precedent for this sentiment. The statement elevates the love of women to the status of a noble prophetic quality, countering any notion that religious piety requires celibacy or disregard for women.
